Triage: **`pm:queue`** — concrete, fully scoped fix (re-word one remedy sentence across the ten locale packs, `check:i18n-drift` forces the other nine in the same PR).

Premise verified this round: objectui `origin/main` @ `6d8231c` — `packages/i18n/src/locales/en.ts:554-555` still says "add a formula field holding it"; objectstack `origin/main` @ `a3c0865` — `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.ts:1903` `UNMATERIALIZED_SORT_TYPES = new Set(['formula'])`, i.e. following our hint lands on the one type the server hard-400s (#6994 made the refusal loud). The advice is actively wrong, not merely stale.

Dedup: repo-scoped search returns only this card; #3950 (grid `sortable` flag on formula columns) and #4243 (sort picker field set, in flight) are correctly distinguished in the body as different surfaces — no convergence needed. Sequencing note for the executor seat: no hard dependency on #4243, but the two cards read better landing in the sorting vocabulary #4243 establishes; serialize if both dispatch near-simultaneously (different files, no merge race expected).

Not `target:v17` (readout for the whole-repo seat's pass): the wrong sentence sends an author to a loud 400, recoverable, no data effect.

本评论来自分诊座位 Routine（#5474 试点），不构成认领。
